items.name: Bonanza Quant Corporation
description: Built a React dashboard for an automated trading system, allowing users to view system status and manage trading strategy settings.
Developed Node.js APIs to connect the dashboard with trading configuration data and backend workflows.
Used MySQL to store strategy configuration, enabling users to update parameters from the web interface.
Integrated Interactive Brokers Market Data API for real-time market data retrieval.
Implemented data processing workflows, including data normalization and technical indicator calculation for quantitative trading strategies.
Implemented trading order workflows by integrating broker APIs.

items.name: Anue
description: Maintained and developed financial news platforms and stock market information products.
Built the Taiwan stock information page from scratch using Next.js: https://www.cnyes.com/twstock
Upgraded the legacy runtime environment from Node.js 8 to Node.js 12, reducing maintenance risk.
Built financial data visualization interfaces with Highcharts and TradingView.
Improved SEO through semantic tags, metadata, and page information structure.
Used Chrome Performance to analyze and improve frontend performance.
Reduced repeated API requests and improved data loading experience with React Query caching.
Integrated GA3, GA4, and Google Tag Manager for user behavior tracking and product analytics.
Improved Git-based development and CI/CD workflows, including Slack release notifications.
